play_radio_station.description: Navigate to Radio and play a live station
steps: open location 'music://music.apple.com/radio' via AppleScript
Screenshot to verify Radio page loaded
click_text on station name (e.g. 'HITS')
Verify player state = playing via AppleScript
Play: tell application 'Music' to play
Pause/Resume: key(combo='space', pid=<music_pid>) — DO NOT use AppleScript 'pause' (times out)
Next track: tell application 'Music' to next track
Previous track: tell application 'Music' to back track  — NOTE: first press restarts current, second press goes to previous
Stop: tell application 'Music' to stop
Volume: tell application 'Music' to set sound volume to 75  -- 0-100
Mute: tell application 'Music' to set mute to true
Shuffle on: tell application 'Music' to set shuffle enabled to true
Repeat all: tell application 'Music' to set song repeat to all  -- off|one|all
Check state: tell application 'Music' to player state  -- playing|paused|stopped

set_eq_preset.description: Enable EQ and switch to a preset via Equalizer UI panel
steps: key(combo='option+cmd+e', pid=<music_pid>) — opens Equalizer window
applescript: tell process 'Music' to tell window 'Equalizer' to click checkbox 1 — turns EQ on (value=1)
applescript: tell process 'Music' to tell window 'Equalizer' to click pop up button 1 — opens preset menu
applescript: click menu item 'Rock' of menu 1 of pop up button 1 — selects preset
Verify: value of pop up button 1 = 'Rock', value of checkbox 1 = 1
set_eq_preset.note: Direct AppleScript 'set EQ enabled to true' fails with -10006. Must use UI automation on the Equalizer window. Available presets: Acoustic, Classical, Dance, Deep, Electronic, Flat, Hip-Hop, Jazz, Latin, Lounge, Piano, Pop, R&B, Rock, Small Speakers, Spoken Word

rate_track.description: Set star rating on a library track
steps: applescript: tell application 'Music' to set rating of track 1 of library playlist 1 to 80
Verify: rating of track 1 of library playlist 1 returns 80
rate_track.note: Rating only works on library tracks (file tracks or downloaded tracks). Radio/URL stream tracks cannot be rated. Song > Rating menu only appears when a library track is selected.

steps: tell application 'Music' to make new playlist with properties {name:"My Playlist"}
tell application 'Music' to set name of playlist "My Playlist" to "Renamed"
tell application 'Music' to delete playlist "Renamed"
tell application 'Music' to search library playlist 1 for "artist name"

search_and_play.description: Search Apple Music catalog and play a track
steps: click_text('Search', windowId=<music_window>, prefer='topmost') to focus search field
type_text('song name')
key(combo='return') to execute search
click_text('Song • ArtistName') to open album page
ui_press(pid=<music_pid>, title='Play', role='AXButton') to play

add_to_library_and_download.description: Add a streaming track to library and download for offline
steps: While track is playing: menu_click(pid, 'Song/Add to Library')
Verify: count of tracks of library playlist 1 increases
menu_click(pid, 'Song/Download') to download for offline
Verify: Song menu shows 'Remove Download' instead of 'Download'

open_ui_panels.description: Open Equalizer, MiniPlayer via keyboard shortcuts
steps: Focus Music: focus(bundleId='com.apple.Music')
Equalizer: key(combo='option+cmd+e', pid=<music_pid>)
MiniPlayer: key(combo='option+cmd+m', pid=<music_pid>)
Playing Next (regular tracks only): key(combo='option+cmd+u', pid=<music_pid>)
Lyrics (regular tracks only): key(combo='ctrl+cmd+u', pid=<music_pid>)
Full Screen Player: key(combo='shift+cmd+f', pid=<music_pid>)
Visualizer: key(combo='cmd+t', pid=<music_pid>)

smart_playlist_creation.description: Create a Smart Playlist with rules
steps: menu_click(pid, 'File/New/Smart Playlist')
Dialog opens with rule editor: field (Artist/Album/Genre/etc) + operator (contains/is/etc) + value
Set limit: 25 items, selected by random/recently added/etc
Toggle 'Live updating' checkbox
ui_press(pid, 'OK') to create

open_stream_url.description: Play a custom audio stream URL
steps: menu_click(pid, 'File/Open Stream URL…') — opens dialog with URL text field
type the stream URL (e.g. http://...mp3 or m3u8)
ui_press(pid, 'OK') to start playing

dismiss_welcome_screen.description: Dismiss Apple Music welcome/onboarding on first launch
steps: Screenshot to detect window 'Window' (586x488) with 'Welcome to Apple Music'
click_text('Start Listening', windowId=<welcome_window_id>)
Home feed will then load properly

tell application "Music" to set mute to true
tell application "Music" to set shuffle enabled to true
tell application "Music" to set song repeat to all  -- off|one|all
tell application "Music" to player state  -- playing|paused|stopped

applescript_eq.description: Control Equalizer — UI automation required for on/off and preset changes
BROKEN: set EQ enabled to true  -- FAILS: -10006 (Can't set EQ enabled)
set current EQ preset to EQ preset 'Rock'  -- FAILS: -1731 (Unknown object type)
working_via_ui: key(combo='option+cmd+e', pid) to open Equalizer window
tell process 'Music' to tell window 'Equalizer' to click checkbox 1  -- toggle on/off
tell process 'Music' to tell window 'Equalizer' to click pop up button 1  -- open presets
click menu item 'Rock' of menu 1 of pop up button 1  -- select preset
value of checkbox 1  -- read EQ state (0=off, 1=on)
value of pop up button 1  -- read current preset name

applescript_rating.description: Set/read track ratings via AppleScript (library tracks only)
examples: set rating of track 1 of library playlist 1 to 80  -- 4 stars
rating of track 1 of library playlist 1  -- read rating (0-100)
set rating of current track to 60  -- 3 stars (only if current track is a file track)

MiniPlayer.features: Compact floating player with album art, track info, playback controls

Playing_Next.note: Works for regular tracks AND radio. Contains Playing Next + History tabs.

History_tab.note: Radio streams NOT logged to history. Only regular tracks appear.

Lyrics.note: Inline in main window for regular tracks. Shows Punjabi/Hindi lyrics correctly. NOT available for radio streams.

Full_Screen_Player.features: Album art + scrolling lyrics + progress bar (elapsed / remaining)

Visualizer.note: Toggles visual animation in main window. No separate window.

song_menu_features.description: Song menu capabilities confirmed via AX tree

items.Add to Library: Adds streaming track to local library. Verify by checking count of tracks of library playlist 1.
items.Download: Downloads track for offline. Confirmed: menu changes to 'Remove Download' after success.
items.Share/Copy Link: Copies Apple Music share link to clipboard.
items.Create Station: Creates Genius radio station from current track.
items.Song Info (Cmd+I): DOES NOT WORK for Apple Music catalog/streaming tracks. Only works for local file tracks in library.

genius_shuffle.description: Genius Shuffle requires minimum library size
genius_shuffle.note: Error: 'Unable to start Genius Shuffle. You do not have enough Genius suggestions in your library.' Needs several tracks in library to work.

errors.pattern: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.cause: No active Apple Music subscription, or not yet dismissed welcome screen
errors.fix: Dismiss 'Welcome to Apple Music' screen first (click 'Start Listening'). If persists, user needs active subscription.

errors.pattern: Can't get name of URL track id N of library playlist id N
errors.cause: Radio stream tracks (class=URL track) don't expose name/artist properties
errors.fix: Use OCR/screenshot on playback bar to read track info for radio streams. Only player state, volume, shuffle, repeat are reliable via AppleScript for radio.

errors.pattern: Can't get duration of current track (-1700)
errors.cause: type mismatch — URL tracks (streaming) don't have duration property
errors.fix: Wrap in try/on error block. Duration only works for file tracks.

errors.pattern: Parameter error (-50) when calling play playlist
errors.cause: Cannot play playlist by name string directly; use playlist object reference
errors.fix: Use: play (first playlist whose name is "Playlist Name")

errors.cause: platform_explore uses process detection that fails for Music despite it running
errors.fix: Skip platform_explore for Music. Use AX tree + AppleScript directly.

errors.pattern: Unable to start Genius Shuffle — not enough suggestions
errors.cause: Library has too few tracks for Genius to generate suggestions
errors.fix: Add more tracks to library first. Genius needs a meaningful library size (10+ tracks recommended).

errors.pattern: Song Info (Cmd+I) does not open for Apple Music catalog tracks
errors.cause: Info panel only works for local file tracks, not streaming URL tracks
errors.fix: First use 'Add to Library' then download the track — then Cmd+I will work on the local copy.

errors.pattern: Lyrics panel shows 'Play a song to see the lyrics here' in main window
errors.cause: When MiniPlayer is active and main window is in background, lyrics panel shows placeholder
errors.fix: Ensure main Music window is focused and a regular (non-radio) track is playing.

errors.pattern: spawnSync /bin/sh ETIMEDOUT when calling 'pause' via AppleScript
errors.cause: applescript 'pause' command can time out during radio/stream playback
errors.fix: Use key(combo='space', pid=<music_pid>) to toggle play/pause. Never use AppleScript 'pause' — use 'key space' instead.

errors.pattern: 'back track' restarts current song instead of going to previous
errors.cause: Apple Music standard behavior: first press of back/previous restarts current track; second press goes to previous
errors.fix: Expected behavior — not a bug. Call back track twice within ~3 seconds to actually go to the previous track.

errors.pattern: set EQ enabled to true fails with -10006
errors.cause: EQ enabled property is not settable via AppleScript in recent Music versions
errors.fix: Use UI automation: open Equalizer window (Option+Cmd+E), then click checkbox 1 via System Events.

errors.pattern: set current EQ preset to EQ preset 'Rock' fails with -1731 (Unknown object type)
errors.cause: EQ preset setter broken in recent Music AppleScript dictionary
errors.fix: Use UI automation on Equalizer window: click pop up button 1, then click menu item 'Rock' of menu 1.
